SELECT p.post_id AS post_id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_post_like l WHERE l.post_id = p.post_id) AS like_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_post_favorite f WHERE f.post_id = p.post_id) AS favorite_count, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tb_post_like l WHERE l.post_id = p.post_id AND l.user_id = #{userId}) AS liked, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tb_post_favorite f WHERE f.post_id = p.post_id AND f.user_id = #{userId}) AS favorited FROM tb_post p WHERE p.post_id IN #{postId}
